scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w glitterfx && npm run build -w @glitterfx/playground && node apps/cdn/build.mjs
scripts.clean: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --clean && node -e "for (const d of ['apps/playground/dist', 'apps/cdn/dist', 'packages/glitterfx/dist', 'packages/glitterfx/build']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run verify:governance
scripts.build:cdn: npm run build -w glitterfx && node apps/cdn/build.mjs
